output_conflict.title: {plant} is held in Dry run
output_conflict.description: {plant} is set to run outside Dry run, but {other_plant} is already out of Dry run and controls {entities}. Two live plants would fight over these entities, so Hydronicus holds {plant} in Dry run because {other_plant} is using the same outputs, and sends no commands from it. Its Dry run setting and confirmed outputs are kept. {plant} resumes automatically when the conflict is gone, for example when {other_plant} enters Dry run, is unloaded, or is removed. To end the conflict for good, bind different entities in one of the plants, remove one of the plants, or turn on Dry run for one of them.
